svg.aria-label: Breadboard with power rails on both long edges; each plus and minus rail is split in the middle and bridged with a short jumper
svg.text: Both long edges have a + and a −. Each is two halves — bridge all four.
Four short jumpers: left +, left −, right +, right −.
Only need one edge for 3V3/GND? Still bridge both + and − on that edge.
